Known references are conservative source callsites, not runtime callers or complete/transitive impact. Dynamic dispatch, unsupported member calls, constructors and tagged templates remain outside binding coverage. Unresolved calls inside source ranges can include nested closures and owned decorators/headers. Python python-lexical-v1 targets ordinary undecorated module definitions or direct from-import aliases; v2 additionally follows one unique unconditional explicit reexport. Longer/rebound/conditional chains, decorated/method targets and runtime module initialization remain unsupported. Java v1 binds bounded same-file static source candidates; v2 additionally binds explicit class-qualified public static paths to captured top-level classes; v3 additionally distinguishes different fixed arities while same-arity/varargs competition, member dispatch and inherited owners remain unresolved. Go v1 binds captured free functions; v2 additionally follows compiler-selected concrete methods, including promotion, expressions and generic instances, while interfaces and function variables remain unknown under incomplete external typing. Argument type applicability and complete compilation are not checked. Historical unrecognized models remain unavailable with unknown totals.
